Definition: from G1223 and G3089; to dissolve utterly:--scatter.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to be dissolved or come to nothing, and it stands once, where Gamaliel reminds the council that Theudas rose up, boasting himself to be somebody, and was slain, and all his followers were scattered and brought to nothing.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Gamaliel's counsel still stands; movements built on a man come to nothing when the man falls, but the work of God cannot be overthrown, and time itself proves which is which.
